item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `Address`, `ContactInfo`, `UserProfile`, and `Note`, plus `complex_tool(profile: UserProfile, priority: int, notes: list[Note] | None = None)` to cover deep nesting and optional list-of-models."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Builds `tool = dspy.Tool(complex_tool)` and inspects `tool.args` as the generated argument schema, which is the DSPy path exercised by the cited implementation."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the `profile` schema is an object and directly checks nested `contact.properties.email.type == \"string\"`, showing the nested object is inlined."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `notes` keeps the nullable `anyOf` form and that the array-items schema directly exposes `content` and `author` as string properties."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Explicitly asserts `\"$defs\" not in str(tool.args[\"notes\"])`, matching the expected reference-resolution behavior."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
